## Unicorn, Lightbringer (CR 7)

This unicorn seems larger and even more majestic than others of its kind. It displays its horn proudly, its radiance almost blinding.  

**XP** 3,200  
CG Large magical beast (good)  
**Init** +5; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision, scent; Perception +16  
**Aura** bless (50 ft.), magic circle against evil (10 ft.)  


**Defense**


**AC** 20, touch 15, flat-footed 14 (+1 dodge, +5 Dex, +5 natural, –1 size; +2 deflection vs. evil)  
**hp** 90 (6d10+30)  
**Fort** +10, **Ref** +10, **Will** +9; +2 resistance vs. evil; **DR** 5/magic and evil  
Immune charm, compulsion, fear, poison; **SR** 18  


**Offense**


**Speed** 60 ft.  
**Melee** gore +13 (2d6+6 plus radiance), 2 hooves +10 (1d3+3)  
**Space** 10 ft.; **Reach** 5 ft.  
**Special Attacks** channel positive energy (4d6, DC 22, 12/day), powerful charge (gore +15, 4d6+9)  
**Spell-Like Abilities** (CL 10th; concentration +19)  


Constant—bless, detect evil, magic circle against evil  

3/day—blinding ray (DC 21), burst of radiance (DC 21), cure moderate wounds, searing light  

1/day—cure critical wounds, greater teleport (within its forest territory), neutralize poison (DC 21), wall of light (DC 24)  



**Statistics**


**Str** 22, **Dex** 21, **Con** 20, **Int** 15, **Wis** 25, **Cha** 28  
**Base Atk** +6; **CMB** +13; **CMD** 29 (33 vs. trip)  
**Feats** Multiattack, Weapon Focus (gore), [Dodgility](../../rules/feats/dodge.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Dodgility.*  
**Skills** Diplomacy +15, Perception +16, Survival +13, Stealth +10  
**Languages** Celestial, Common, Sylvan  
**SQ** wild empathy +23  


**Special Abilities**


**Channel Positive Energy (Su)** As a standard action, a lightbringer unicorn can channel positive energy in a 30-foot burst as a 7th-level good cleric. This ability requires no divine focus.  

**Radiance (Su)** The horn of a lightbringer unicorn constantly shines as if under the effect of the daylight spell, which the lightbringer unicorn can suppress or resume as a free action. When the horn is shining, a creature hit by the lightbringer unicorn’s gore attack must succeed at a DC 22 Fortitude save or be permanently blinded. A creature that succeeds at this save is instead dazzled for 1 round. The save DC is Charisma-based.  

**Wild Empathy (Su)** This works like the druid’s wild empathy class feature, except the lightbringer unicorn has a +8 racial bonus on the check.  


**Ecology**


**Environment** temperate forests  
**Organization** solitary, pair, or crusade (3-6)  
**Treasure** standard
